description: Vlad's Playbook — a 48-chapter operator field manual where every artifact is live, clickable, and forwardable. 31 interactive widgets, a self-updating AI radar, hand-verified model leaderboards, embedded case studies — and the repo runs the agent workflow the book teaches.
